content: Guides Home Guides How to Get Copper Ore in Pokémon Pokopia: Complete Guide Resources & How to Get 2026-06-06 How to Get Copper Ore in Pokémon Pokopia: Complete Guide Learn where to find Copper Ore in Pokémon Pokopia and how to farm it fast. Mine copper with Rock Smash in Rocky Ridges and Rocky Dream Island, then smelt it into Copper Bars. Author : Pokopia Guide Team Copper Ore is a key mining material in Pokémon Pokopia, used to craft the Pokémon Center rebuild kit, the Fountain Plaza kit, and Scrap blocks. It's smelted into Copper Bars for higher-tier recipes. This guide covers where to find Copper Ore, how to mine it efficiently, and how to process it. Where to Find Copper Ore Copper Ore is mined from copper-bearing rocks — gray boulders with orange-brown copper veins running through them. There are two main locations: Location How to Access Notes Rocky Ridges Town Story progression (3rd area) Found in the mine and around the rocky terrain Rocky Dream Island Use the Clefairy Doll with Drifloon Best farming spot — resets daily How to Mine Copper Ore To break copper-bearing rocks, you need the Rock Smash move (learned from Hitmonchan during the Rocky Ridges story). Good news: Unlike harder ores such as Gold or Iron, Copper Ore rocks can be broken with a non-powered Rock Smash . You don't need to eat a Hamburger Steak first — though powering up still speeds things up. Each copper rock you break drops Copper Ore that you pick up with Y . Best Way to Farm Copper Ore (Recommended) The most efficient method is mining at Rocky Dream Island : Find or obtain the Clefairy Doll (Piepi Doll) and show it to Drifloon to travel to Rocky Dream Island Eat a Hamburger Steak to power up Rock Smash and Rollout for faster mining Use Rollout to plow through copper deposits on the ground and inside the island quickly Break wall-mounted copper rocks with Rock Smash Return the next day — Dream Islands reset at 5:00 AM , so the copper respawns See the full Dream Island guide for all doll locations and island types. Tip: If you don't want to wait for the daily reset, change the date on your Nintendo Switch 2 to refresh the island and mine again immediately. How to Smelt Copper Ore into Copper Bars Most advanced recipes require Copper Bars , not raw Copper Ore. To smelt: Place the Copper Ore into a Blast Furnace Assign a Pokémon with the Burn specialty (such as Growlithe, Torchic, or Magmar) Wait for processing — 1 Copper Ore = 1 Copper Bar What Copper Ore Is Used For Use Materials Required Scrap block Crafting material Fountain Plaza Kit Lumber ×20, Stone ×20, Copper ×20 Pokémon Center Rebuild Kit Stone ×25, Iron ×25, Copper ×25, Crystal ×5 Copper Bar recipes Smelt first, then use in furniture and tools Quick Tips Farm at Rocky Dream Island — it's the most efficient and resets every day Eat a Hamburger Steak — powering up Rollout lets you collect copper in bulk Stockpile early — the Pokémon Center rebuild kit alone needs 25 Copper Smelt in batches — assign a Burn Pokémon to the Blast Furnace and process multiple ores at once Use the date-change trick — refresh the Dream Island instantly instead of waiting for the 5 AM reset Previous Resources & How to Get How to Make Concrete in Pokémon Pokopia: Mixer & Limestone Next Gameplay Guides How to Get the Game Boy in Pokopia & All Uses Found incorrect data? title: How to Get Ice in Pokémon Pokopia Guide
description: How to get Ice in Pokémon Pokopia. Two confirmed locations — Palette Town's secret cave and Rock Peak Dream Island — plus Freezing Chambers build requirements for Articuno.
content: Guides Home Guides How to Get Ice in Pokémon Pokopia Resources & How to Get 2026-05-10 How to Get Ice in Pokémon Pokopia How to get Ice in Pokémon Pokopia. Two confirmed locations — Palette Town's secret cave and Rock Peak Dream Island — plus Freezing Chambers build requirements for Articuno. Author : Pokopia Guide Team Ice is one of the harder materials to find in Pokopia because it only appears in two specific locations. It is also one of the most important — you need 50 Ice to build the Freezing Chambers , the construction required to unlock Articuno . Do not spend Ice on decoration until you have secured enough for the build. Fast Answer Primary source: Secret cave behind the waterfall in Palette Town — hundreds of Ice blocks available Secondary source: Rock Peak Dream Island via Drifloon (requires Clefairy Doll) — smaller amount inside the rocky structure at the center Location 1: Palette Town Secret Cave (Best Source) This is by far the most efficient Ice farming spot in the game. How to reach it: Head to Palette Town (accessible via the road through Withered Wastelands) Find the waterfall on the eastern side of the area Move to the right side of the waterfall and look for a Glow Mushroom Walk toward it — you will enter a hidden passage Follow the path inside to reach a large chamber filled with Ice blocks and Crystal Shards This room respawns its resources, making it the go-to farming spot whenever you need to restock Ice. Location 2: Rock Peak Dream Island (Secondary Source) A smaller but reliable supplement if you are already farming Dream Islands. Requirements: Access to Drifloon's Dream Island system Clefairy Doll (required to unlock Rock Peak Dream Island) Once on Rock Peak Dream Island, find the rocky structure at the center of the island. Ice blocks are located inside. The yield is smaller than the Palette Town cave, but it is worth picking up if you are running the island for other resources. What Ice Is Used For Freezing Chambers (Articuno Habitat) The primary use for Ice is building the Freezing Chambers — the large construction kit that causes Articuno to appear. This is a required step for full Pokédex completion. Materials needed: Material Amount Stone ×50 Ice ×50 Crystal Shard ×10 Pokemetal ×10 Pokémon crew required: 1× Pokémon with Build specialty 1× Pokémon with Water specialty 1× Pokémon with Search specialty 12× any additional Pokémon Total: 15 Pokémon Construction takes approximately one in-game day. Because of its large size, clear and flatten a wide open area before placing the kit. Where to find the kit: The Freezing Chambers kit is located on the eastern island where you first arrive in Palette Town. After Building Once the Freezing Chambers is complete, Articuno appears inside. It prefers a Cool environment, so place cool-type furniture nearby to raise its comfort level. Farming Tips Do the Palette Town cave first — it gives you 50 Ice in a single run, which is exactly what you need for the Freezing Chambers Pick up Crystal Shards at the same time — the secret cave contains both Ice and Crystal Shards, letting you farm two Freezing Chambers materials in one trip Save Ice before decorating — Ice can be used for decoration, but secure your 50 for the build first Rock Peak Dream Island is a bonus stop , not a primary route — use it when you are already there for other items like Seashells or Twine Related Guides Palette Town Guide Dream Island Guide How to Get Crystal Fragments All Crafting Materials in Pokémon Pokopia Previous Gameplay Guides Pokopia CoroCoro Island Guide: Address Code & All Items Next Gameplay Guides Pokopia Public Island Codes: All Official Virtual Mode Addresses Found incorrect data? description: Learn how to make Concrete in Pokémon Pokopia. Craft the Concrete Mixer, farm Limestone efficiently, use a Crush Pokémon, and see how much Concrete every kit needs.
content: Guides Home Guides How to Make Concrete in Pokémon Pokopia: Mixer & Limestone Resources & How to Get 2026-06-11 How to Make Concrete in Pokémon Pokopia: Mixer & Limestone Learn how to make Concrete in Pokémon Pokopia. Craft the Concrete Mixer, farm Limestone efficiently, use a Crush Pokémon, and see how much Concrete every kit needs. Author : Pokopia Guide Team Concrete is one of the most-needed building materials in Pokémon Pokopia. You'll burn through it building houses, lift stations, elevators, and the larger town kits. This guide covers how to make Concrete, where to farm Limestone fast, and exactly how much Concrete each recipe needs. How to Make Concrete Concrete is produced by putting Limestone into a Concrete Mixer . Three things are required: A crafted Concrete Mixer The mixer placed next to water A Pokémon with the Crush specialty (such as Conkeldurr ) in that town Add Limestone to the mixer, bring over your Crush Pokémon, and it will grind the Limestone into Concrete. The mixer only works when placed next to water . If nothing happens, check that it's at the water's edge and that a Crush Pokémon lives in that town. How to Get the Concrete Mixer The Concrete Mixer recipe is learned during the Sparkling Skylands story, when you accept Conkeldurr's request . Once unlocked, craft it at a workbench and you can make as many mixers as you need. Tip: Crafting multiple Concrete Mixers lets you process several batches of Limestone at once — the single biggest time-saver for bulk Concrete. Where to Find Limestone Limestone is the bottleneck for Concrete, so knowing the best sources matters: Location Notes Rocky Dream Island Most efficient — use the Clefairy Doll, resets daily Rocky Ridges Town Inside the hot spring cave Sparkling Skylands Southeast of Tinkmaster's house Limestone comes from breaking the white striped rocks with Rock Smash. Best Way to Farm Limestone (and Concrete) The fastest method is farming Rocky Dream Island : Use the Clefairy Doll with Drifloon to travel to Rocky Dream Island Break all the Limestone rocks and collect everything Return home and feed it into your Concrete Mixers Come back the next day — the island resets at 5:00 AM , so Limestone respawns If you don't want to wait, change the date on your Nintendo Switch 2 to refresh the island and farm again immediately. How Much Concrete You Need Concrete is required in large amounts as you progress. Some key recipes: Recipe Concrete Needed House Foundation 1 White Line Path (vertical / horizontal) 2 each Lift Station 5 Elevator Station 8 Yellow Hut Kit 10 City House Kit 20 Grand City Kit 25 Because the bigger kits each need 10–25 Concrete, it pays to stockpile Limestone early. Quick Tips Build multiple Concrete Mixers — process Limestone in parallel Farm Rocky Dream Island daily — the most reliable Limestone source Keep a Crush Pokémon in town — Conkeldurr is the standard choice Place mixers at the water's edge — they won't run otherwise Stockpile before big builds — the Grand City Kit alone needs 25 Concrete For the related Control Unit and Paper materials, see the Paper, Concrete & Control Unit guide .
